question: Show names for all stadiums except for stadiums having a concert in year 2014.
schema_links: Schema_links: [stadium.Name, stadium.Stadium_ID, concert.Stadium_ID, concert.Year, concert.Stadium_ID = stadium.Stadium_ID]
classification_result:
Reason: The query needs to exclude stadiums that had a concert in 2014, which is typically done using a subquery such as NOT IN to identify those stadiums first.
Label: NESTED
Sub_questions: ["Find Stadium_IDs of stadiums that have a concert in year 2014.", "Find names of stadiums whose Stadium_ID is not in the list of stadiums from the first sub-question."]
generated_sql: SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Stadium_ID NOT IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE Year = 2014);
corrected_sql: SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Stadium_ID NOT IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM concert WHERE Year = 2014);
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stadium EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year  =  2014
